W: While the secular bear market and death cross remain, the slight improvement in long-term range position offers a minor offset. The fundamental strengths of Microsoft continue to provide a floor. T: Risk has slightly increased due to the widening secular bear market decline, but remains contained by the strong fundamentals and improved range position. Conviction remains relatively high due to the enduring fundamental strengths and strategic importance of AI, though tempered by the persistent secular bear market. The score has been slightly adjusted downwards to reflect the worsening secular bear market conditions.
